name: Hospitality English — First Week at Work MVP — VERIFIED

title.es: Tu primera semana en el trabajo
title.it: La tua prima settimana di lavoro
title.pt: A tua primeira semana no trabalho
title.de: Deine erste Woche bei der Arbeit

subtitle.es: Inglés práctico para entender a tu equipo, pedir ayuda y adaptarte a tu nuevo trabajo.
subtitle.it: Inglese pratico per capire il team, chiedere aiuto e adattarti al nuovo lavoro.
subtitle.fr: De l’anglais pratique pour comprendre votre équipe, demander de l’aide et vous adapter à votre nouveau poste.
subtitle.pt: Inglês prático para entender a tua equipa, pedir ajuda e adaptar-te ao novo trabalho.
subtitle.de: Praktisches Englisch, um dein Team zu verstehen, um Hilfe zu bitten und dich an den neuen Job anzupassen.
subtitle.pl: Praktyczny angielski, który pomoże ci rozumieć zespół, prosić o pomoc i odnaleźć się w nowej pracy.
subtitle.ro: Engleză practică pentru a-ți înțelege echipa, a cere ajutor și a te adapta la noul loc de muncă.
subtitle.uk: Практична англійська, щоб розуміти команду, просити допомогу й адаптуватися до нової роботи.
subtitle.nl: Praktisch Engels om je team te begrijpen, hulp te vragen en je aan je nieuwe baan aan te passen.
subtitle.en: Practical English for understanding your team, asking for help and settling into a new job.

what_you_need.es: No tienes que fingir que has entendido. Es mejor pedir que repitan o expliquen una instrucción.
what_you_need.it: Non devi fingere di aver capito. È meglio chiedere di ripetere o spiegare un’istruzione.
what_you_need.fr: Vous n’avez pas besoin de faire semblant d’avoir compris. Il vaut mieux demander de répéter ou d’expliquer une consigne.
what_you_need.pt: Não precisas de fingir que percebeste. É melhor pedir para repetir ou explicar uma instrução.
what_you_need.de: Du musst nicht so tun, als hättest du alles verstanden. Bitte lieber darum, eine Anweisung zu wiederholen oder zu erklären.
what_you_need.pl: Nie musisz udawać, że wszystko rozumiesz. Lepiej poprosić o powtórzenie lub wyjaśnienie polecenia.
what_you_need.ro: Nu trebuie să pretinzi că ai înțeles. Este mai bine să ceri repetarea sau explicarea instrucțiunii.
what_you_need.uk: Не треба вдавати, що ти все зрозумів/зрозуміла. Краще попросити повторити або пояснити інструкцію.
what_you_need.nl: Je hoeft niet te doen alsof je het begrepen hebt. Vraag liever om herhaling of uitleg.
what_you_need.en: You don't need to pretend you understood. It's better to ask for an instruction to be repeated or explained.

useful_phrases_en: Sorry, could you repeat that?
Could you show me how you want this done?
Just to make sure I understood…
scenarios.example_en: Manager: Please restock this section before service. You: Sure. Just to make sure I understood, do you want everything fully restocked before 5?

prompt.es: ¿Qué haces si no entiendes una instrucción?
prompt.it: Cosa fai se non capisci un’istruzione?
prompt.fr: Que faites-vous si vous ne comprenez pas une consigne ?
prompt.pt: O que fazes se não percebes uma instrução?
prompt.de: Was machst du, wenn du eine Anweisung nicht verstehst?
prompt.pl: Co robisz, jeśli nie rozumiesz polecenia?
prompt.ro: Ce faci dacă nu înțelegi o instrucțiune?
prompt.uk: Що робити, якщо не розумієш інструкцію?
prompt.nl: Wat doe je als je een instructie niet begrijpt?
prompt.en: What should you do if you don't understand an instruction?

options_en: Pretend you understood.
Ask them to repeat or explain it.
Ignore the task.

what_you_need.es: Pedir ayuda a tiempo es mejor que dejar que un problema crezca durante el servicio.
what_you_need.it: Chiedere aiuto in tempo è meglio che lasciare crescere un problema durante il servizio.
what_you_need.fr: Demander de l’aide à temps vaut mieux que laisser un problème s’aggraver pendant le service.
what_you_need.pt: Pedir ajuda a tempo é melhor do que deixar um problema crescer durante o serviço.
what_you_need.de: Rechtzeitig um Hilfe zu bitten ist besser, als ein Problem während des Services größer werden zu lassen.
what_you_need.pl: Lepiej poprosić o pomoc na czas niż pozwolić, by problem narastał podczas serwisu.
what_you_need.ro: Este mai bine să ceri ajutor la timp decât să lași o problemă să se agraveze în timpul serviciului.
what_you_need.uk: Краще вчасно попросити допомогу, ніж дозволити проблемі зрости під час зміни.
what_you_need.nl: Op tijd om hulp vragen is beter dan een probleem tijdens de service groter laten worden.
what_you_need.en: Asking for help early is better than letting a problem grow during service.

useful_phrases_en: Could you give me a hand for a moment?
Can you help me with this table/order?
I'm not sure about this — can I check with you?
scenarios.example_en: You: Could you give me a hand for a moment? I'm getting behind with these orders. Colleague: Sure, I'll take this one.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál es la mejor forma de pedir ayuda?
prompt.it: Qual è il modo migliore per chiedere aiuto?
prompt.fr: Quelle est la meilleure façon de demander de l’aide ?
prompt.pt: Qual é a melhor forma de pedir ajuda?
prompt.de: Wie bittest du am besten um Hilfe?
prompt.ro: Care este cel mai bun mod de a cere ajutor?
prompt.nl: Wat is de beste manier om hulp te vragen?
prompt.en: What is the best way to ask for help?

options_en: Say nothing and hope someone notices.
Ask clearly and explain what you need.
Complain that nobody is helping.

what_you_need.es: Aprende a preguntar dónde y cuándo puedes hacer tu descanso sin sonar exigente.
what_you_need.it: Impara a chiedere dove e quando puoi fare la pausa senza sembrare esigente.
what_you_need.fr: Apprenez à demander où et quand prendre votre pause sans paraître exigeant.
what_you_need.pt: Aprende a perguntar onde e quando podes fazer a pausa sem parecer exigente.
what_you_need.de: Lerne, höflich nach Ort und Zeitpunkt deiner Pause zu fragen.
what_you_need.pl: Naucz się pytać, gdzie i kiedy możesz zrobić przerwę, bez roszczeniowego tonu.
what_you_need.ro: Învață să întrebi unde și când poți lua pauza fără să pari pretențios.
what_you_need.uk: Навчися ввічливо питати, де й коли можна зробити перерву.
what_you_need.nl: Leer hoe je vraagt waar en wanneer je pauze kunt nemen zonder veeleisend te klinken.
what_you_need.en: Learn how to ask where and when you can take your break without sounding demanding.

useful_phrases_en: When would be a good time for me to take my break?
Where is the staff room?
Should I clock out for my break?
scenarios.example_en: You: When would be a good time for me to take my break? Manager: Around 4, once the rush is over.

prompt.fr: Quelle question est la plus professionnelle ?

options_en: I'm taking my break now, okay?
When would be a good time for me to take my break?
Why haven't I had a break yet?

what_you_need.es: Tienes que poder confirmar tus turnos, preguntar por cambios y evitar malentendidos con los horarios.
what_you_need.it: Devi saper confermare i turni, chiedere dei cambi ed evitare malintesi sugli orari.
what_you_need.fr: Vous devez pouvoir confirmer vos horaires, demander des changements et éviter les malentendus.
what_you_need.pt: Tens de conseguir confirmar os turnos, perguntar sobre alterações e evitar mal-entendidos.
what_you_need.de: Du solltest Schichten bestätigen, nach Änderungen fragen und Missverständnisse vermeiden können.
what_you_need.pl: Musisz umieć potwierdzać zmiany, pytać o zmiany grafiku i unikać nieporozumień.
what_you_need.ro: Trebuie să poți confirma turele, întreba despre schimbări și evita neînțelegerile.
what_you_need.uk: Потрібно вміти підтверджувати зміни, питати про зміни графіка й уникати непорозумінь.
what_you_need.nl: Je moet diensten kunnen bevestigen, naar wijzigingen vragen en misverstanden voorkomen.
what_you_need.en: You need to be able to confirm shifts, ask about changes and avoid misunderstandings about times.

useful_phrases_en: Am I still on the rota for Friday evening?
What time would you like me to start?
Has the rota changed for next week?
scenarios.example_en: You: Has the rota changed for next week? Manager: Yes, you're starting at 4 instead of 5 on Saturday.

prompt.it: Quale frase conferma chiaramente un orario?
prompt.fr: Quelle phrase confirme clairement un horaire ?
prompt.pt: Qual frase confirma claramente um horário?
prompt.de: Welcher Satz bestätigt eine Zeit klar?
prompt.nl: Welke zin bevestigt een tijd duidelijk?
prompt.en: Which sentence clearly confirms a shift time?

options_en: I think I'm in on Saturday.
Just to confirm, I'm starting at 4 on Saturday, right?
I'll see what happens on Saturday.

what_you_need.es: Pide cambios con tiempo y deja claro que entiendes que deben aprobarse.
what_you_need.it: Chiedi i cambi con anticipo e fai capire che sai che devono essere approvati.
what_you_need.fr: Demandez les changements à l’avance et montrez que vous comprenez qu’ils doivent être approuvés.
what_you_need.pt: Pede alterações com antecedência e deixa claro que sabes que precisam de aprovação.
what_you_need.de: Bitte frühzeitig um Änderungen und zeige, dass du weißt, dass sie genehmigt werden müssen.
what_you_need.pl: Proś o zmianę z wyprzedzeniem i pokaż, że rozumiesz, że wymaga ona akceptacji.
what_you_need.ro: Cere schimbări din timp și arată că înțelegi că trebuie aprobate.
what_you_need.uk: Проси про зміни завчасно й покажи, що розумієш: їх потрібно погодити.
what_you_need.nl: Vraag wijzigingen op tijd aan en maak duidelijk dat je begrijpt dat ze goedgekeurd moeten worden.
what_you_need.en: Ask for changes early and make it clear you understand they need approval.

useful_phrases_en: Would it be possible to swap my shift on Sunday?
I've found someone who can cover it, if that's okay.
I understand if it can't be changed.
scenarios.example_en: You: Would it be possible to swap my Sunday shift? I've found someone who can cover it, if that's okay with you.

prompt.es: ¿Qué enfoque es mejor para cambiar un turno?
prompt.it: Qual è l’approccio migliore per cambiare un turno?
prompt.fr: Quelle est la meilleure approche pour échanger un service ?
prompt.pt: Qual é a melhor abordagem para trocar um turno?
prompt.de: Wie gehst du am besten bei einem Schichttausch vor?
prompt.pl: Jak najlepiej podejść do zamiany zmiany?
prompt.ro: Care este cea mai bună abordare pentru schimbarea unei ture?
prompt.uk: Як найкраще підійти до обміну зміною?
prompt.nl: Wat is de beste aanpak om een dienst te ruilen?
prompt.en: What is the best approach to changing a shift?

options_en: Tell the manager you won't be coming.
Ask early and wait for approval.
Swap with someone without telling anyone.

what_you_need.es: Pregunta qué debe estar terminado, en qué orden y quién comprueba el cierre o la apertura.
what_you_need.it: Chiedi cosa deve essere completato, in che ordine e chi controlla l’apertura o la chiusura.
what_you_need.fr: Demandez ce qui doit être terminé, dans quel ordre et qui vérifie l’ouverture ou la fermeture.
what_you_need.pt: Pergunta o que deve ficar concluído, por que ordem e quem verifica a abertura ou o fecho.
what_you_need.de: Frage, was erledigt werden muss, in welcher Reihenfolge und wer Öffnung oder Schluss kontrolliert.
what_you_need.pl: Zapytaj, co ma być zrobione, w jakiej kolejności i kto sprawdza otwarcie lub zamknięcie.
what_you_need.ro: Întreabă ce trebuie terminat, în ce ordine și cine verifică deschiderea sau închiderea.
what_you_need.uk: Запитай, що має бути виконано, у якому порядку й хто перевіряє відкриття або закриття.
what_you_need.nl: Vraag wat af moet zijn, in welke volgorde en wie opening of sluiting controleert.
what_you_need.en: Ask what needs to be finished, in what order and who checks the opening or close.

useful_phrases_en: What are my closing duties tonight?
Is there a checklist I should follow?
Can you check this before I finish?
scenarios.example_en: You: Is there a closing checklist I should follow? Manager: Yes, it's next to the till. Ask me before you leave if anything is unclear.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase ayuda a evitar olvidos al cerrar?
prompt.it: Quale frase aiuta a evitare dimenticanze in chiusura?
prompt.fr: Quelle phrase aide à éviter les oublis à la fermeture ?
prompt.pt: Qual frase ajuda a evitar esquecimentos no fecho?
prompt.de: Welcher Satz hilft, beim Schließen nichts zu vergessen?
prompt.pl: Które zdanie pomaga uniknąć pominięć przy zamknięciu?
prompt.ro: Care propoziție ajută la evitarea omisiunilor la închidere?
prompt.uk: Яка фраза допомагає нічого не забути під час закриття?
prompt.nl: Welke zin helpt om niets te vergeten bij het afsluiten?
prompt.en: Which phrase helps you avoid missing tasks at close?

options_en: Is there a checklist I should follow?
I'll just do what looks important.
Someone else will probably finish it.

what_you_need.es: Aclara desde el principio qué uniforme, presentación y estándares espera el local.
what_you_need.it: Chiarisci fin dall’inizio quale uniforme, presentazione e standard richiede il locale.
what_you_need.fr: Clarifiez dès le départ l’uniforme, la présentation et les standards attendus par l’établissement.
what_you_need.pt: Esclarece desde o início o uniforme, a apresentação e os padrões esperados pelo local.
what_you_need.de: Kläre von Anfang an, welche Kleidung, welches Erscheinungsbild und welche Standards erwartet werden.
what_you_need.pl: Od początku wyjaśnij, jaki strój, wygląd i standardy obowiązują w lokalu.
what_you_need.ro: Clarifică de la început ce uniformă, prezentare și standarde cere locația.
what_you_need.uk: Відразу уточни, яку форму, зовнішній вигляд і стандарти очікує заклад.
what_you_need.nl: Vraag vanaf het begin welke kleding, uitstraling en standaarden de zaak verwacht.
what_you_need.en: Clarify from the beginning what uniform, presentation and standards the venue expects.

useful_phrases_en: Is there a specific uniform I need to wear?
Are black shoes required?
Is there anything specific I should know about presentation standards?
scenarios.example_en: You: Is there a specific uniform I need to wear tomorrow? Manager: Yes, black shirt, black trousers and black non-slip shoes.

prompt.es: ¿Qué pregunta es más útil antes del primer turno?
prompt.it: Quale domanda è più utile prima del primo turno?
prompt.fr: Quelle question est la plus utile avant le premier service ?
prompt.pt: Qual pergunta é mais útil antes do primeiro turno?
prompt.de: Welche Frage ist vor der ersten Schicht am nützlichsten?
prompt.pl: Które pytanie jest najbardziej przydatne przed pierwszą zmianą?
prompt.ro: Care întrebare este cea mai utilă înainte de prima tură?
prompt.uk: Яке запитання найкорисніше перед першою зміною?
prompt.nl: Welke vraag is het nuttigst voor je eerste dienst?
prompt.en: Which question is most useful before your first shift?

options_en: Is there a specific uniform I need to wear?
Can I wear anything comfortable?
Does anyone really care what shoes I wear?

title.fr: Apprendre les produits et le menu

what_you_need.es: Durante la primera semana no lo sabrás todo. Aprende a pedir recursos, prioridades y aclaraciones.
what_you_need.it: Durante la prima settimana non saprai tutto. Impara a chiedere risorse, priorità e chiarimenti.
what_you_need.fr: Pendant la première semaine, vous ne saurez pas tout. Apprenez à demander des ressources, des priorités et des précisions.
what_you_need.pt: Na primeira semana não vais saber tudo. Aprende a pedir recursos, prioridades e esclarecimentos.
what_you_need.de: In der ersten Woche wirst du nicht alles wissen. Frage nach Lernmaterial, Prioritäten und Erklärungen.
what_you_need.pl: W pierwszym tygodniu nie będziesz wiedzieć wszystkiego. Naucz się prosić o materiały, priorytety i wyjaśnienia.
what_you_need.ro: În prima săptămână nu vei ști totul. Învață să ceri resurse, priorități și clarificări.
what_you_need.uk: У перший тиждень ти не знатимеш усього. Навчися просити матеріали, пріоритети й пояснення.
what_you_need.nl: In je eerste week weet je nog niet alles. Leer om hulpmiddelen, prioriteiten en uitleg te vragen.
what_you_need.en: You won't know everything in your first week. Learn to ask for resources, priorities and clarification.

useful_phrases_en: What should I learn first?
Is there a menu or product guide I can study?
Which items do guests ask about most often?

example_by_role.bartender: You: Which drinks should I focus on learning first? Manager: Start with the signature cocktails and the wines by the glass.
example_by_role.waiter: You: Which menu items should I focus on learning first? Manager: Start with the best sellers, allergens and today's specials.

prompt.it: Quale domanda ti aiuta a dare priorità?
prompt.fr: Quelle question vous aide à prioriser ?
prompt.pt: Qual pergunta te ajuda a definir prioridades?
prompt.de: Welche Frage hilft dir zu priorisieren?
prompt.ro: Care întrebare te ajută să stabilești prioritățile?
prompt.nl: Welke vraag helpt je prioriteiten te stellen?

options_en: What should I learn first?
Do I really need to learn all this?
Can someone else answer every question for me?

what_you_need.es: El feedback durante la primera semana es normal. Escucha, confirma qué debes cambiar y aplícalo.
what_you_need.it: Il feedback durante la prima settimana è normale. Ascolta, conferma cosa devi cambiare e applicalo.
what_you_need.fr: Le feedback pendant la première semaine est normal. Écoutez, confirmez ce que vous devez changer et appliquez-le.
what_you_need.pt: O feedback durante a primeira semana é normal. Ouve, confirma o que deves mudar e aplica-o.
what_you_need.de: Feedback in der ersten Woche ist normal. Höre zu, kläre, was du ändern sollst, und setze es um.
what_you_need.pl: Informacja zwrotna w pierwszym tygodniu jest normalna. Słuchaj, potwierdź, co trzeba zmienić, i zastosuj to.
what_you_need.ro: Feedbackul în prima săptămână este normal. Ascultă, clarifică ce trebuie schimbat și aplică.
what_you_need.uk: Зворотний зв’язок у перший тиждень — це нормально. Вислухай, уточни, що змінити, і застосуй це.
what_you_need.nl: Feedback in je eerste week is normaal. Luister, bevestig wat je moet veranderen en pas het toe.
what_you_need.en: Feedback in your first week is normal. Listen, clarify what needs to change and apply it.

useful_phrases_en: Thanks, I'll make sure I do that next time.
Just to clarify, you want me to…?
Is there anything else I should improve?
scenarios.example_en: Manager: Please acknowledge guests sooner, even if you're busy. You: Got it. I'll make sure I do that next time.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál es la mejor respuesta al feedback?
prompt.it: Qual è la risposta migliore al feedback?
prompt.fr: Quelle est la meilleure réponse au feedback ?
prompt.pt: Qual é a melhor resposta ao feedback?
prompt.de: Was ist die beste Reaktion auf Feedback?
prompt.pl: Jaka jest najlepsza reakcja na feedback?
prompt.ro: Care este cel mai bun răspuns la feedback?
prompt.uk: Яка найкраща реакція на зворотний зв’язок?
prompt.nl: Wat is de beste reactie op feedback?
prompt.en: What is the best response to feedback?

options_en: Argue immediately.
Listen, clarify and apply it.
Ignore it unless another manager says the same thing.

what_you_need.es: Antes de irte, confirma que tus tareas están terminadas y que nadie necesita nada más de ti.
what_you_need.it: Prima di andare via, conferma che i tuoi compiti siano finiti e che nessuno abbia bisogno di altro.
what_you_need.fr: Avant de partir, confirmez que vos tâches sont terminées et que personne n’a besoin de vous pour autre chose.
what_you_need.pt: Antes de ires embora, confirma que as tuas tarefas estão concluídas e que ninguém precisa de mais nada.
what_you_need.de: Bevor du gehst, bestätige, dass deine Aufgaben erledigt sind und niemand noch etwas von dir braucht.
what_you_need.pl: Przed wyjściem potwierdź, że twoje zadania są zakończone i nikt nie potrzebuje już twojej pomocy.
what_you_need.ro: Înainte să pleci, confirmă că sarcinile tale sunt terminate și că nimeni nu mai are nevoie de tine.
what_you_need.uk: Перед тим як піти, переконайся, що твої завдання завершені й нікому більше не потрібна твоя допомога.
what_you_need.nl: Controleer voor je weggaat of je taken klaar zijn en niemand je nog nodig heeft.
what_you_need.en: Before you leave, confirm that your tasks are finished and nobody needs anything else from you.

useful_phrases_en: Is there anything else you need me to do before I finish?
I've finished my closing tasks.
Am I okay to clock out?
scenarios.example_en: You: I've finished my closing tasks. Is there anything else you need me to do before I finish? Manager: No, that's everything. Thanks.

prompt.it: Cosa dovresti fare prima di andare via?
prompt.fr: Que devriez-vous faire avant de partir ?
prompt.pt: O que deves fazer antes de ir embora?
prompt.de: Was solltest du tun, bevor du gehst?
prompt.ro: Ce ar trebui să faci înainte să pleci?
prompt.uk: Що варто зробити перед тим, як піти?
prompt.nl: Wat moet je doen voordat je weggaat?
prompt.en: What should you do before leaving?

options_en: Leave as soon as your scheduled time arrives.
Confirm your tasks are done and check whether anything else is needed.
Wait for someone to notice you're still there.

home_priority_conditions: profile.goal == improve_current_job AND guest has very low completed-situation count
personalization.role_variant: Use profile.role only where example_by_role exists. Otherwise use shared content.
personalization.venue_type: May affect Home ranking only; no venue-specific rewriting in MVP.

ux_contract: Useful phrases and examples remain English.
Use role-specific example only where provided.
1 lightweight MC practice item per scenario.
Completion page shows 10/10 + practice score X/10.
No audio, Speaking, AI, gamification or paywall in MVP.

future_hooks.listening: Manager/colleague lines can later become listening audio.
future_hooks.speaking: User can later answer manager/colleague prompts by voice.
future_hooks.tonights_shift: Future version may source one First Week item when employment_status == starting_new_job.
future_hooks.emergency_phrases: May later link directly to related saved phrases.
